text:
nico_sales: quick internal handoff for Aurelia Foods (mid-market retail). Ran a production demo Friday. overall onboarding green but a few high-priority asks: SAML SSO, a short private-eval window in Feb, and an estimate for reserved capacity with committed discounts. renewal date: 2026-02-14. customer comment: "we need to trim ~20% off current run costs".

nico_sales: important: during the demo they hit intermittent 500s on long receipts when calling /v1/generate. reported request-id: req_e9f4a11b. they want triage before their exec check-in next week.

jamie_cs: thanks Nico. i'll own the onboarding kickoff and the enablement deck. @oliver_cs_manager can you own the capacity/pricing scenarios? @maya_support can you take the 500s? @leo_engineer can you look at model fallback / runtime settings?

oliver_cs_manager: on it. i'll produce three reserved-capacity scenarios (small commit, medium w/ burst, annual discount) and include estimated token costs and expected latency profiles. aim: Tue EOD. looping in finance for final numbers.

maya_support: need a sample failing payload + headers to reproduce. was the prompt a huge multi-turn catalog? any sequence length estimate? also which region/gpu did the customer hit?

nico_sales: pasted a sanitized curl below. customer id: aurelia-001. admin contact: emma@aureliafoods.com.

nico_sales: ```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-large-1","prompt":"<long product catalog + multi-turn context>...","max_tokens":1200}'
# HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
# x-request-id: req_e9f4a11b
```

leo_engineer: i'll pick this up. creating ticket INF-4109. first hypothesis: OOM during kernel launch for long sequences or heavy KV-cache pressure. can you paste the server logs around that request id?

infra-bot: INF-4109 created (severity P2) by leo_engineer. https://issues.redwood.dev/INF-4109

maya_support: repro attempt in staging with a reduced-length prompt reproduced the 500. stack: "kernel_launch_failed -> CUDA out of memory". i attached the staging trace to INF-4109 and left notes about the gpu type (A100) and quant config.

leo_engineer: thanks. please include the exact env vars and quantization flags. quick mitigation: try lowering max_tokens to 800 and enable prefix caching. if that helps we can recommend routing to redwood-medium-1 for long estimated sequences as a fallback.

jamie_cs: immediate owners and actions:
- CS kickoff meeting (owner: jamie_cs) — invite: emma (customer), sales, support, eng. target Mon 10am PT.
- Support triage (owner: maya_support) — confirm root cause and add complete logs to INF-4109. target: EOD today.
- Engineering mitigation (owner: leo_engineer) — propose fallback routing + config changes (prefix cache, max_tokens guidance). target: 24h.
- Pricing & capacity estimate (owner: oliver_cs_manager) — 3 scenarios + committed discounts + private eval pricing. target: Tue COB.

nico_sales: customer also asked for latency baselines (95p token latency) and a rough cost per 1M tokens for both medium & large models plus quantized variants. include those in the enablement deck.

oliver_cs_manager: will pull console metrics for the relevant models and quant profiles and include a one-slide comparison.

maya_support: quick workaround note: in staging the 500 disappeared when i reduced max_tokens and turned on prefix caching. i left the exact prefix config in INF-4109 comments.

leo_engineer: good sign. i'll open a routing PR to add a short-term rule: if sequence_estimate > 1024 route to redwood-medium-1, allow controlled burst to large for validated sessions. will attach PR once ready.

nico_sales: uploaded demo recording + contract to shared folder: https://files.redwood.example/aurelia-onboarding (access: cs/support/eng).

jamie_cs: adding customer notes for the playbook: "must have SAML SSO before production", "prefers committed discount to reduce unit price", "expects predictable latency for long receipts". will synthesize into the kickoff deck.

oliver_cs_manager: created JIRA CS-4950 for the renewal play and updated onboarding checklist. owners: jamie_cs + oliver_cs_manager. check-in next week.

maya_support: flagged region capacity concerns for a private eval in Feb in INF-4109 — will confirm region availability and infra window.

leo_engineer: created PR https://git.redwood.dev/routing/PR-689 with the fallback rule (WIP). linking tests once CI finishes.

jamie_cs: i'll schedule the kickoff and a 15-min pre-call to walk eng through logs. inviting emma. :calendar:

oliver_cs_manager: i'll draft the renewal outreach email and include a warm pricing slide once the estimate is finalized. owners update Tue 9am PT.

nico_sales: appreciated — please keep INF-4109 and CS-4950 updated. ping me for exec escalation if needed.

maya_support: copying key notes into INF-4109 now. will post root-cause summary once confirmed. :white_check_mark:

leo_engineer: will post mitigation PR link + CI results into INF-4109 when available.

jamie_cs: closing thread for now — reopening after kickoff scheduling. :lock:
